name: checksum_document_worked_example
note: The document's own vector, digit for digit: '64 bits to checksum: 060E 2B34 0200 81BB', then 060E + 2B34 = 3142, + 0200 = 3342, + 81BB = B4FD. It checks this repository's bcc_16 against the standard instead of against itself. NOTE the range is given rather than found: §6.6 defines the real range in terms of the checksum item's length field, and locating that needs the length grammar parks 4 and 8 own.
